title: SREV-064 RPCRT string binding pointer gate contract

out_binding.description: Caller-provided output pointer for the binding handle

local_rewrite.description: Sandboxie RPC port binding rewrite path before RPCRT4 is called

contracts: RpcBindingFromStringBindingW takes a pointer to a string binding and an output binding pointer
The Sandboxie wrapper may parse StringBinding only after StringBinding is non-null and not the 0x4 sentinel
The Sandboxie wrapper may call RPCRT4 or trace the returned handle only after OutBinding is non-null
Invalid pointer-shaped input returns RPC_S_INVALID_ARG before local wide-string parsing
The existing spooler dynamic-port rewrite remains behind the same pointer gate
